revisions.title: The pressure point: who gets to judge?
revisions.body: I take Socrates’ maneuver here as a test of what the measure can tolerate. If a person’s judgment is authoritative simply because it is that person’s, then a judgment against Protagoras’ doctrine cannot be dismissed merely for opposing it. The theory is made to face the judgments it would authorize—and that is its pressure point.
